Target 7 (Desktop App Interface) is incorrectly implemented. The current driver/desktop/app.go has:

**Current (incorrect):**
- Interface named "DesktopApp" with method SystemTray() *fyne.Menu

**Required (from original task, Target 7):**
- Interface named "App" (so it's referenced as desktop.App)
- Two methods:
  - SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu) — sets the system tray menu
  - SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource) — sets the system tray icon

The original task explicitly states: "Define a new interface in driver/desktop/app.go with two methods" and lists those two setter methods. The current implementation has a getter method instead of the required setters, and uses the wrong interface name.

Please update driver/desktop/app.go to match the requirements before completing the task.
